author: 9xvi
title: Cool, but horrible tracking.
content: I love this concept and I was ready to spend a few hours just starting out, and I’m already a fitness enthusiast. I already do competitive rock, climbing, etc, so I know how to do push-ups properly.  It keeps losing track of where my hips are, and it keeps making my shoulders the hip point, so it counts my push-up until my hips are obscured, but if I’m gonna do a proper push-up facing the camera, my hips should never be below my chest.  If the push-up starts out in proper form and hips are where they need to be, assume the hips stay where they need to be, and just go off of arm angle and shoulder angle and chest distance from floor, there’s no reason to have to have the hips in there the whole time.  That being said, awesome idea, still have the app still won’t deleted, but please work on this.  I have a few friends who could benefit from something like this to get them into Fitness and I wouldn’t want them to get the discouraged.
